# build-speedup-bench

> Composite GitHub Action at tuannx/maven/.github/actions/build-speedup-bench. Wall-clocks one Maven reactor and appends a markdown table to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Personal fork only. Do not open pull requests or comments on apache/maven or any other third-party repo for this action.

## Adopt

Checkout the project under test, then one `uses` line. `v1` is a moving tag cut on master after merge. It does not exist until a human pushes it. Until then, pin a commit SHA.

```yaml
permissions:
  contents: read

steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
  - uses: tuannx/maven/.github/actions/build-speedup-bench@v1
    with:
      pom: pom.xml
```

Dogfood in this repo: `uses: ./.github/actions/build-speedup-bench` with `pom: api/pom.xml`. Workflow: `.github/workflows/build-speedup-bench.yml`. Job name / PR check: `build-speedup-bench`.

Pass the aggregator POM to `pom` (`mvn -f`). Do not use `-pl <module> -am` from a parent reactor.

Runner: `ubuntu-latest` with `python3`, `curl`, `tar`, `sha256sum`, `sha512sum`. Set the job `timeout-minutes` to at least 45.

## Inputs

| name | required | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| pom | no | pom.xml | `-f` path |
| scenarios | no | mvn,mvnd,build-cache | comma-separated subset of `mvn`, `mvnd`, `build-cache` |
| maven-version | no | 3.9.11 | host Maven; Central `.sha512` verified |
| mvnd-version | no | 1.0.6 | daemon; `build-cache` runs `mvnd` |
| mvnd-sha256 | no | empty | required if version is not 1.0.6 on linux-amd64 and the release has no `.sha256` asset |
| mvn-runs | no | 3 | timed `mvn clean package` count. Median is the middle sample. 2 makes the median the average of a pair |
| mvnd-warm-runs | no | 3 | timed warm `mvnd clean package` count after one cold run. Same median reason as mvn-runs |
| threads | no | 1C | `-T` |
| extra-maven-args | no | -DskipTests -Drat.skip=true -Dcheckstyle.skip=true -Denforcer.skip=true | whitespace-separated; no spaces inside a single argument |
| java-version | no | 21 | used only when setup-java is true |
| java-distribution | no | temurin | actions/setup-java distribution |
| setup-java | no | true | false means JAVA_HOME is already set |
| touch-file | no | empty | java file for mtime touch and one-line edit; empty discovers the first `src/main/java/**/*.java` under the POM directory |
| upload-logs | no | false | true uploads `bench-logs/` for 14 days via step "Upload timing logs" (`actions/upload-artifact`) and requires `actions: write` |
| artifact-name | no | build-speedup-bench-logs | artifact name |
| sticky-comment | no | false | true runs step "Update sticky pull request comment": update one issue comment whose body contains `<!-- build-speedup-bench -->`. Requires `pull-requests: write`. No effect if the event is not pull_request |

Every timed command is `mvn|mvnd -f <pom> --batch-mode -q <extra-maven-args> -T <threads> [clean] package`.

`build-cache` copies `extensions.xml` and `maven-build-cache-config.xml` from this action directory into the caller `.mvn/` after the baseline, then deletes those two files. maven-build-cache-extension version is 1.2.0. The action refuses to start if `.mvn/extensions.xml` or `.mvn/maven-build-cache-config.xml` already exists.

## Outputs

| name | type | example | empty when |
|---|---|---|---|
| mvn-median-seconds | decimal seconds | 12.98 | scenario `mvn` not run |
| warm-mvnd-seconds | decimal seconds | 4.26 | scenario `mvnd` not run |
| warm-mvnd-speedup | decimal ratio, no x suffix | 3.04 | mvn median or warm median missing |
| cache-no-change-seconds | decimal seconds | 0.44 | scenario `build-cache` not run |
| summary-path | workspace-relative path | bench-logs/summary.md | not empty after the measure step |

Speedup column in the table is `mvn median / seconds`. Higher is faster. Job summary also lists these outputs.

## Permissions

| scope | needed |
|---|---|
| contents: read | caller checkout. Sufficient when upload-logs and sticky-comment stay at their defaults (both false) |
| actions: write | only when upload-logs is true. Step name: "Upload timing logs". Action: actions/upload-artifact |
| pull-requests: write | only when sticky-comment is true. Step name: "Update sticky pull request comment" |

Run count: default 3 for mvn-runs and mvnd-warm-runs. On the api/ dogfood a 2-run job was under 2 minutes; one extra host mvn clean is about 13s and one extra warm mvnd clean is about 4s, so 3 stays far under 10 minutes. Two runs are noisier because the median is then the average of the pair. Do not default to 4.

## Does not

- Fail the job when warm mvnd is not faster than mvn. Emits `::warning::` and still exits 0 if the builds exit 0.
- Leave the build-cache extension installed.
- Modify product source. The one-line edit is restored from a byte copy before exit.
- Run Surefire, the core IT suite, or a full Apache release build unless the caller points `pom` at that reactor and removes skip args.
- Create git tags or GitHub releases.
- Open pull requests or comments on apache/maven or any repo other than the caller. `sticky-comment` comments only on the caller pull request, and only when the input is true.

## Tag

After merge to master, a human cuts the moving major tag (do not invent a tag from CI):

```bash
git fetch origin master
git tag -f v1 origin/master
git push -f origin v1
```

Consumers then use `@v1`. Move the tag forward for compatible action fixes. Do not force-move it for an input or output rename; use a new major tag.
